concept: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished FULL primary application screen, 1536x1024, for a small Chinese desktop companion app named 八奈见的小卖部. This is an actual usable app UI not a marketing landing page. Warm ivory paper background, navy blue typography, dusty sky-blue panels, restrained butter-yellow accents, delicate Japanese stationery aesthetics. Top compact wordmark 八奈见的小卖部 and navigation 专注采购 / 零食抽屉 / 收藏册. Main two-column panel: LEFT a soft pale blue arched stage with the small chibi blue-haired schoolgirl from the supplied reference atlas (use just ONE original standing pose, maintain original character outfit/appearance), and a small speech balloon saying 路过便利店，要带什么吗？. RIGHT generous title 你专心，我去逛逛。 and subtitle 留一段时间给手边的事，回来的路上带点甜。, duration choices 15分钟 / 25分钟 / 45分钟 with 25 selected, full navy primary button 开始专注, restrained secondary textbutton 体验一次（30秒） with caption 不计入专注记录. Beneath main panel a wide paper-like 零食抽屉 preview containing six small isolated illustrated snacks: custard pudding, melon bread, strawberry milk carton, onigiri, taiyaki, three-colour dango. Each has label and x1. Bottom quiet status 今天，从一份小点心开始。 and local save indication. Modern Chinese sans-serif body, elegant slightly literary title. Clear practical hit targets, balanced whitespace, rounded cards modestly 20px, no fake charts, no gradients, no emojis. The original atlas is only a character reference; do not reproduce atlas grid, do not change original character actions.
snacks: Use case: stylized-concept. Production artwork atlas for a cozy Japanese snack-collection app. Output 1536x1024 landscape, EXACT regular 3 columns x 2 rows grid, six square 512x512 cells. Each isolated snack centered in its cell, all art confined to center 300x300 with generous pure white #FFFFFF padding. Top-left caramel custard pudding with tiny whipped cream and cherry on simple small saucer; top-middle golden Japanese melonpan crosshatch bread; top-right pink strawberry milk carton with a tiny strawberry illustration but NO text or logo; bottom-left triangular rice onigiri with crisp dark nori wrap; bottom-middle golden fish-shaped taiyaki; bottom-right three-color pink white green dango on a bamboo skewer on small dish. Cohesive charming hand-painted anime game inventory illustration, delicate navy-brown outlines, soft cel shading, warm natural colors, subtle tiny grounded shadow. Objects at consistent visual scale, appetizing and premium, clean readable silhouette at 96px. Flat completely white background entire image, NO grid lines, NO borders, NO text, NO captions, NO labels, NO watermark, NO characters, NO hands, NO extra scattered objects. Separate six snack cells with large blank margins.
